purpose: Primary-source discrepancies found while extending PR118 EN/IT origin histories to ES/FR/DE/PT. Must be reconciled in canonical base record before editorial approval.

items.currentBaseClaim: Republic Act No. 3022, approved 6 April 1961, proclaimed annual 9 April Bataan Day as legal holiday.
items.missingBefore: Philippine President Ramon Magsaysay had already proclaimed 9 April 1956 Bataan Day and a special nationwide public holiday, via Proclamation No. 277 dated 23 March 1956.
correctedChronology: 1942-04-09: Bataan forces surrendered; ensuing forced march
1956-03-23: Proclamation No. 277 declared 9 April 1956 a special public holiday for Bataan Day
1961-04-06: Republic Act No. 3022 made 9 April an annual legal holiday with one minute of silence at 16:30
1987: Executive Order 203 used Araw ng Kagitingan/Day of Valor among regular holidays
items.requiredChange: Amend PR118 canonical EN/IT to mention 1956 special nationwide proclamation before 1961 annual holiday law. Original master chronology currently incomplete, not false that the 1961 law was established.

items.discrepancy: Senate Legislative Reference Bureau header says Date of Approval: February 15, 1921, while official full text directly underneath says Approved, February 16, 1921. The PDF/full law and Supreme Court edition should be checked to establish controlling date.
items.requiredChange: Keep legally secure year 1921; either use February 1921 without precise day in final article until verified, or resolve inconsistency with primary reproduction; do not silently prefer metadata to full text.
